name: Extract From File
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: A common pattern in n8n workflows is to receive a file, either from an [HTTP Request node][] (for files you are fetching from a website), a [Webhook Node][] (for files which are sent to your workflow from elsewhere), or from a local source. Data obtained in this way is often in a binary format, for example a spreadsheet or PDF

operations.description: The "Comma Separated Values" file type is commonly used for tabulated data
Extract fields from standard web page HTML format files
Extract JSON data from a binary file
Extract fields from iCalendar format files
Extract fields from ODS spreadsheet files
Extract fields from Portable Document Format files
Extract fields from Rich Text Format files
Extract fields from a standard text file format
Extract fields from a Microsoft Excel file (older format)
Extract fields from a Microsoft Excel file
Converts binary data to a text-friendly [base64][] format

parameters.name: Input Binary Field
parameters.description: Enter the name of the field from the node input data that contains the binary file. The default is 'data'

parameters.name: Destination Output Field
parameters.description: Enter the name of the field in the node output that will contain the extracted data

options.name: delimiter
options.description: Set the field delimiter, usually a comma

options.name: enableBOM
options.description: Whether to detect and exclude the byte-order-mark from the CSV Input if present

options.name: relaxQuotes
options.description: Whether to handle unclosed quotes in CSV fields as part of the field's content instead of throwing a parsing error

options.name: headerRow
options.description: Whether the first row of the file contains the header names

options.name: includeEmptyCells
options.description: Whether to include empty cells when reading from file. They will be filled with an empty string.

options.name: maxRowCount
options.description: Stop handling records after the requested number of rows are read. Use -1 if you want to load all rows.

options.name: range
options.description: The range to read from the table. If set to a number it will be the starting row. If set to string it will be used as A1-style notation range.

options.name: rawData
options.description: Whether to return RAW data, instead of parsing it

options.name: readAsString
options.description: In some cases and file formats, it is necessary to read as string to ensure special characters are interpreted correctly

options.name: sheetName
options.description: Name of the sheet to read from in the spreadsheet

options.name: fromLine
options.description: Start handling records from the requested line number. Starts at 0.

parameters.name: destinationKey
parameters.description: The name of the output field that will contain the extracted data

options.name: encoding
options.description: Specify the encoding of the file, defaults to UTF-8

options.name: stripBOM
options.description: Whether to strip the BOM (Byte Order Mark) from the file, this could help in an environment where the presence of the BOM is causing issues or inconsistencies

options.name: joinPages
options.description: Whether to join the text from all pages or return an array of text from each page

options.name: maxPages
options.description: Maximum number of pages to include

options.name: password
options.description: Prowide password, if the PDF is encrypted
